name: ev_charging_cost
title: EV charging cost per 100 km
description: What 100 km costs in an electric car at a given price per kWh, for four driving levels, next to other EVs and a petrol car. All inputs are URL query parameters, so a filled-in link reproduces the view.
formula: cost_per_100km = kwh_per_100km * (1 + losses_pct / 100) * price_per_kwh; break_even_price = litres_per_100km * price_per_litre / (kwh_per_100km * (1 + losses_pct / 100))

car.description: Car name. A known name also sets lv from the built-in estimates.

lv.description: Four consumption levels in kWh/100 km, comma separated: efficient, typical, motorway 120 km/h, winter.

loss.description: Charging losses between plug and battery.

fl.description: Petrol car consumption to compare with. 0 hides it.

refs.description: Other cars to show, comma separated, from the cars list.
